text.en:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Eksais (Pengecualian)

(Pindaan) 2016.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 Oktober 2016.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Perintah Duti Eksais (Pengecualian) 2013 [P.U. (A) 379/2013] dipinda dalam

Bahagian I Jadual berhubung dengan butiran 6, dengan menggantikan butir-butir dalam

ruang (3) di bawah kepala "Goods exempted" dan butir-butir dalam ruang (4) di bawah

kepala "Conditions" dengan butir-butir yang berikut:

(3)

Goods exempted

(4)

Conditions

"Undenatured ethyl alcohol (a) That the undenatured ethyl alcohol is imported

or purchased from a licensed manufacturer;

(b) that the undenatured ethyl alcohol is imported

or purchased solely to be used in the

manufacture of Compounded Hard Liquor

(CHL) under section 20 of the Excise Act 1976;

(c) any other conditions as the Director General

may deem fit to impose"

Dibuat 5 Oktober 2016

[SULIT KE. HT(96)669/20-4 Klt.2 SK. (6); Perb. CR(8.20)116/1-121(SJ.1) Jld. 7(SK.3)(22);

PN(PU2)337/XX]

DATUK JOHARI BIN ABDUL GHANI

Menteri Kewangan Kedua

EXCISE ACT 1976

EXCISE DUTIES (EXEMPTION) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(1) of the

Excise Act 1976 [Act 176], the Minister makes the following order:
